answer: Bind every agent key to one physical secure chip. At registration the agent submits its TPM endorsement certificate; the ledger stores the cert hash and rejects any second key from that chip. Chips cost about $30, so 1,000 sybils need $30,000 of separate hardware, not one script. Whether a key writes a sonnet or appraises willow and cedar timber, payouts reach only chip-backed keys, and a chip whose keys collude is blacklisted for 90 epochs.
